english.title: Place / leave vehicle / bicycle / conveyance in a manner to cause obstruction on the Tyne and Wear Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) while in charge of a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[bicycle,]_
(C)_[conveyance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONVEYANCE..),]_

left or placed it on a part of the Tyne and Wear Metro, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), in such a manner or place as to cause an obstruction or hindrance to an Operator or any other person using the Metro
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 14(2)(i) and 31(1) of the Tyne and Wear Metro Byelaws made under sections 58 and 62 of the Tyneside Metropolitan Railway Act 1973.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 30 make provisions in relation to name and addresses.
(ii) Byelaw 31(2) provides powers for the removal of persons.
(iii) Byelaw 31(3) provides that when using these powers, an authorised person, including a constable, must show his/her identification if requested.
(iv) Byelaw 31(6) provides that in relation to this byelaw: An authorised person acting in the course of his duties shall not be liable for breach of this byelaw.
(v) Byelaw 31(4) provides that no person shall be subject to any penalty for breach of any of the Byelaws by disobeying a notice unless it is proved to the satisfaction of the Court before whom the complaint is laid that the notice referred to in the particular Byelaw was displayed.
